# BEIJING NORTH REFRACTORIES CO., LTD.

> Chinese manufacturer and supplier of ceramic fiber blankets, calcium silicate boards, and fiber cement products for industrial and construction applications.

BEIJING NORTH REFRACTORIES CO., LTD. is a specialized producer of refractory and insulation materials based in Beijing, China. The company manufactures a comprehensive range of thermal insulation products including ceramic fiber blankets, calcium silicate boards, fiber cement boards, and magnesium oxide boards, serving industrial, construction, and consumer markets with OEM/ODM capabilities and export to North America, South America, and Southeast Asia.

## Key Topics

- Ceramic Fiber Blankets
- Calcium Silicate Board
- Fiber Cement Board
- Refractory Materials
- Industrial Insulation
- Building Materials
- Thermal Insulation
- Construction Products
- OEM/ODM Services
- China Export
- Magnesium Oxide Board
- Bio Soluble Fiber
- Microporous Insulation
- Ceramic Fiber Products
- Made in China
